modal.introTitle: 💧 Welcome to AabPashi – Your Smart Water Assistant
modal.introBody:
AabPashi is designed to help farmers manage water supply efficiently and confidently. You no longer need to wait or guess when water will arrive. AabPashi gives you:

✅ Timely water schedule alerts
📊 Canal status and priority updates
🗺️ An easy map to check canal information
🔈 Audio guidance in your language
🌐 Full support in English and Urdu

🌾 Whether you grow wheat, sugarcane, cotton, or vegetables, AabPashi helps you save time, reduce risk, and increase your crop yield with smart water planning.

🚀 Let’s begin.
Click 'Get Started with AabPashi' to see your water schedule, or view tutorials to learn more.

projects.title: Projects
projects.overviewText: Aab Pashi’s Water Stewardship Program enhances water efficiency in agriculture through technology-driven irrigation strategies and sustainable farming practices. By optimizing water use, reducing waste, and improving crop yields, the program helps farmers conserve water while maintaining productivity.
projects.sustainabilityStatement: By integrating technology, data analytics, and economic incentives, Aab Pashi’s Water Stewardship Program empowers farmers to maximize productivity while conserving water resources. The program aligns with global best practices in agricultural water management, ensuring long-term sustainability.

impactData.text: Agriculture uses around 70% of all water withdrawals.
In 2022, over 50% of global catchment areas and reservoirs displayed deviations from normal conditions.
Around half of the world’s population experiences severe water scarcity for at least some part of the year.
Droughts between 1970 and 2019 led to over 700,000 drought-related deaths and over 260 billion USD of economic losses.
Between 2001 and 2018, around 74% of all natural disasters were water-related.
Around 1.8 billion people face significant flood risk worldwide.
